# Steady 2.21.16

## What's new
- **System Tracer gone** — “show system apps” only lists packages that actually have a launcher icon (no Traceur / hidden agent apps).
- **Honest sponsors** — removed network-name scrubbing from reward pages; rewards require an explicit Continue tap (no silent auto-grant).
- **No baked-in GitHub write PAT** — the APK no longer embeds a reverse-engineerable sync token. Updates stay on public releases; sync uses the token already saved on the device (or set in Parent settings).
- **Home customization**
  - Dock: adjustable size (5–10), multi-page swipe, optional labels; removed redundant SOS Call button (use Phone on the dock).
  - Layout: Continuous / Pages / Drag & folders; optional “move restricted apps aside.”
  - Header: show/hide + compact/expanded; streak / time-left toggles.
  - App widgets: opt-in (off by default) then appear on Home.
  - Wallpaper parallax (respects reduce motion).

## For parents
Update both phones. Open **Home settings** to try layout / dock / widgets. Open Steady once after install so prefs apply.
